integrity: Constructive positive-semidefinite Gram completion proves the exact fiber factorization; strict log convexity and tree-degree majorization prove all-order extrema. Python standard-library tests are finite supporting checks, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to a graph obtained by adjoining a universal vertex to a tree; standard edge-correlation Lebesgue volume only. Star specialization previously published; no claim of historical priority beyond inspected literature. Converse of degree-multiset invariance not asserted.
title: Degree-sequence volumes and sharp tree extrema for suspended graph elliptopes
